violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: a can opener.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC cleaned, rinsed and sanitized a can opener.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS instructed PIC to clean out the mop heads, rinse them, and hang up the mops to air dry.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy of the written vomiting/diarrhea clean-up policy.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR FOOD THERMOMETER DURING INSPECTION.
